title: Counter
emptyBill: Scan a pack, or search for a product above, to start a bill.
unsureSaved: {message} We couldn't tell if the bill was saved. Try again: it is never billed twice.
confirmEditBody: The last try may have been saved. Look in Bills first: if it's there, don't bill it again, start a new bill instead. Changing it now and saving makes a new bill.
savedStartNew: It was saved: start a new bill

clearBody.one: The item comes off. Nothing was saved yet, so nothing else changes.
clearBody.other: All {count} items come off. Nothing was saved yet, so nothing else changes.

billFull: A bill takes up to {max} items: save this one and start another.
lineGone: Removed from your products meanwhile: take it off this bill.
lessThanGram: That's less than a gram at {price}/kg
looseWeightLabel: Weight in kg (0.5 for half a kilo)
looseAmountLabel: Amount in ₹ the customer asks for
otherNameError: Enter what it is (2 to 100 letters)
soldOften: Sold often? Add it to your products, so its stock is kept and it scans.
helperDiscountMax: A helper can take up to ₹10 off. Ask the owner for more.
helperDiscountHint: Up to ₹10, to round off. The owner can give more.
paidNowHint: Part paid at the counter: only the rest goes on their khata.
paidInFull: Paid in full? Use Cash or UPI instead. Paid now must be less than {amount}.
repeatedBill: This bill was already saved from your earlier try: it wasn't billed twice.
totalChanged: The saved bill is {saved}, not the {shown} the screen showed (a price changed meanwhile). Charge {saved}.
upiFailedCash: UPI didn't work: paid by cash instead
noUpiId: No QR: the shop's UPI ID isn't set.
askOwnerUpi: Ask the owner to set it.
openBill: Open the bill (cancel, returns, change payment)
barcodeSavedBillFull: Barcode saved. A bill takes up to {max} items: save this one and start another.
unknownBarcode: Barcode {code} isn't in your products yet
alreadyHaveProduct: It's a product I already have
whichProduct: Which product has barcode {code}? It scans as that product from now on.
packHint: 1 for a single pack; 12 if this barcode is on a carton of 12.
cameraAria: Camera: hold the barcode inside the box
cameraDenied: The camera is blocked for this app. In the installed app: long-press the app icon → App info → Permissions → Camera → Allow. In Chrome: tap ⋮ → Site settings → Camera → Allow. Or type the barcode's digits below.
cameraNone: This phone's camera can't be used here. Type the barcode's digits below.
scannerNotLoaded: The scanner couldn't load. Check your internet and open it again, or type the barcode's digits below.
typeDigits: Or type the digits under the barcode
qrFailed: Couldn't draw the QR. Ask them to pay to the UPI ID below.
